featured_reviews.name: T G Kinholkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our heartfelt thanks to Dr. Shirish Kakade Sir.
My wife was suffering from severe knee pain for the last 5 years. At the same time, when the doctor of Virar hospital had advised us to undergo total knee replacement surgery, but this operation was not successful, after hearing this we canceled it, tried many medicines from outside but there was no benefit, Dr. Ashwini Singh. Sir referred me to Shirish Kakade sir. Knee replacement surgery was done on 19-08-2023. Now he is able to walk without any support as well as climb stairs. I cannot express my gratitude towards Dr. Shirish Kakade sir in a few words. He is simply the definition of what a doctor should be: compassionate, dedicated, inspiring and down to earth. All our relevant and most irrelevant queries were answered without any complaints. Each procedure before and after surgery was explained in detail. On top of that, he makes a personal call to monitor the progress. Our heartfelt thanks to the doctor with prayers to God to give him enough strength to serve the society.
They also give personal attention which is the best thing. I would recommend every person who is facing similar problem to visit Dr.Shirish Kakade sir
